items.title: Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers
items.one_liner: Stocks that beat the market over the past year kept beating it over the following months. Reproduced on the paper's own weighting, the result comes back within 0.03 points of the published number. What happened after 2009 is a harder question than it looks.
items.quotable: Reproducing Jegadeesh and Titman on equal weighted deciles gives 1.33 percent a month over their 1965 to 1989 sample, against the 1.31 percent they published.
